Mattermost.note: Brand name; never translate. Declined with a hyphen in the existing catalog ('Mattermost-a', 'Mattermost-u'); prefer rephrasing to avoid declension.

Enterprise Edition.note: Keep in English. The existing catalog once renders it 'Izdanje za poduzeća' (about.teamEditiont1) — do not follow that.

Team Edition.note: Keep in English. Existing 'Timsko izdanje' (about.teamEditiont0) is a legacy rendering.

Mattermost Cloud.note: Keep in English. Do not render 'Cloud' as 'Oblak' (about.cloudEdition does).

Channels.note: Product name; keep in English. The common noun 'channels' is 'kanali'.

Calls.note: Product name; keep in English. The common noun 'call' is 'poziv'.

LDAP.note: 'AD/LDAP' stays as-is; declined with a hyphen when needed ('AD/LDAP-a').

MFA.note: Keep the abbreviation. Spelled-out form in existing strings is 'višefaktorska autentifikacija'.

Gossip.note: Protocol name; never render literally as 'trač'/'ogovaranje'.

System Console.note: Feminine. No settled rendering in the existing catalog (all strings empty); use 'Konzola sustava' consistently, matching 'administrator sustava'.

marketplace.note: The existing catalog keeps the English 'Marketplace' (5 occurrences); keep it. Do not render as 'tržnica'.

post.note: Existing permission/moderation strings use 'objava'; in user-facing prose 'poruka' is used interchangeably with message.

thread.note: Feminine; plural 'niti'. No settled rendering in the existing catalog (threading.* strings are empty); use 'nit' consistently, Threads view = 'Niti'. Avoid 'rasprava' and 'tema'.

direct message.note: Consistent existing rendering (16 occurrences). Not 'direktna poruka'. Abbreviation DM is not expanded.

group message.note: The existing catalog has 'poruka grupe' in two strings; prefer 'grupna poruka' as the natural adjective form.

bookmark.note: Feminine; plural 'zabilješke'. Channel bookmarks = 'zabilješke kanala'. Verb: 'dodaj zabilješku'.

emoji.note: Masculine, indeclinable in the existing catalog ('prilagođeni emoji', genitive 'emojija').

status.note: The existing catalog consistently renders user status as 'stanje' ('Postavi stanje', 'Poništi stanje'); keep it. Technical status columns also use 'Stanje'.

do not disturb.note: Status label. DND is not abbreviated in Croatian.

online.note: Existing catalog uses 'online' ('svi koji su online'); status label 'Online'. Alternative 'Na mreži' is not used.

out of office.note: Status label; prose uses 'nisam u uredu'.

guest.note: Masculine; plural 'gosti'. Guest access = 'pristup za goste'.

sign in.note: Both 'sign in' and 'log in' = 'prijavi se' (noun 'prijava'). The existing catalog addresses the user informally ('ti'); keep that register.

sign out.note: Both 'sign out' and 'log out' = 'odjavi se' (noun 'odjava'). The existing catalog has the typo 'Odajvi se' — do not copy it.

join.note: Takes dative: 'pridruži se kanalu', 'pridruži se timu'.

mute.note: Existing: 'Isključi zvuk kanala'; unmute = 'Uključi zvuk'; muted = 'isključen zvuk' / 'utišan'. Not 'utišaj' as the button label.

favorite.note: Sidebar category 'Favoriti'. Verb: 'Dodaj u favorite'; unfavorite: 'Ukloni iz favorita' (existing).

trigger word.note: Existing rendering ('Riječ za pokretanje naredbe'); plural 'riječi za pokretanje'. Not 'okidač'.

plugin.note: Existing rendering ('Prenesi dodatak', 'Dodatak nije pronađen'); plural 'dodaci', genitive plural 'dodataka'. Not 'plugin'/'priključak'.

license.note: Verb 'licenciran' (existing 'Licenzirano' is a typo — do not copy).

seat.note: No existing rendering; plural 'korisnička mjesta'. Short 'mjesto' where context is clear.

trial.note: Free trial = 'besplatno probno razdoblje'; 'trial license' = 'probna licenca'.

invite.note: Verb (existing 'Pozovi'); as a noun use 'poziv' or 'pozivnica'.

unread.note: Adjective agrees: 'nepročitani kanali', 'nepročitane poruke'; Unreads view = 'Nepročitano'.

attachment.note: Masculine; plural 'privici'. The catalog mixes 'privitak' and 'prilog'; prefer 'privitak'.

urgent.note: Priority label (existing); adjective agrees in prose ('hitna poruka'). 'Important' = 'Važno'.

recap.note: Masculine; plural 'sažeci'. 'Summary' also renders as 'sažetak'; add 'aktivnosti' when disambiguation is needed.

burn-on-read.note: Adjectival use: 'poruka koja se briše nakon čitanja'; label 'BRISANJE NAKON ČITANJA'.

personal access token.note: Existing rendering ('osobni tokeni za pristup'); bare 'token' stays 'token'.

permalink.note: Existing menu label is 'Kopiraj poveznicu'; use 'trajna poveznica' where the term itself is named.

username.note: The catalog contains the typo 'korisičko ime' — do not copy it.

collapsed reply threads.note: 'Collapsed' = 'sklopljeno' in the existing catalog; capitalise as a feature name 'Sklopljene niti odgovora'.

access control.note: Attribute-based access control = 'kontrola pristupa temeljena na atributima'; policy = 'pravilo'.

attribute.note: Masculine; plural 'atributi'. Custom profile attribute = 'prilagođeni atribut profila'.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in the server catalog.

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in the server catalog.

server.note: The existing catalog uses 'server' (not 'poslužitelj'); declined normally ('serveru', 'servera').
